claim: The maritime counterpart of a military group carried out Operation Neptune Spear and is sometimes referred to in the U.S. media as a Special Mission Unit. Joshua Wheeler was the leader of this military group.
evidencia:
Page: Death of Osama bin Laden. Sentence: Osama bin Laden, the founder and head of the Islamist group Al-Qaeda, was killed in Pakistan on May 2, 2011, shortly after 1:00 am PKT (20:00 UTC, May 1) by United States Navy SEALs of the U.S. Naval Special Warfare Development Group (also known as DEVGRU or SEAL Team Six).
Page: Death of Osama bin Laden. Sentence: The operation, code-named Operation Neptune Spear, was carried out in a CIA-led operation, with Joint Special Operations Command, commonly known as JSOC, coordinating the Special Mission Units involved in the raid.
Page: Death of Osama bin Laden. Sentence: In addition to SEAL Team Six, participating units under JSOC included the 160th Special Operations Aviation Regiment (Airborne), aka "Night Stalkers," and operators from the CIA's Special Activities Division, which recruits heavily from former JSOC Special Mission Units.
Page: SEAL Team Six. Sentence: The United States Naval Special Warfare Development Group (NSWDG), commonly known as DEVGRU or SEAL Team Six is the U.S. Navy component of Joint Special Operations Command.
Page: SEAL Team Six. Sentence: Despite the official name changes, "SEAL Team Six" remains the unit's widely recognized moniker.
Page: SEAL Team Six. Sentence: It is sometimes referred to in the U.S. media as a Special Mission Unit.
Page: Delta Force. Sentence: Delta Force and DEVGRU perform the most highly complex, classified, and dangerous missions in the U.S. military, as directed by the U.S. National Command Authority.
Page: Joshua Wheeler. Sentence: Joshua L. Wheeler (22 November 1975 – 22 October 2015) was a United States Army Special Forces Operational Detachment-Delta (aka Delta Force) Master Sergeant who was killed in Iraq during Operation Inherent Resolve.

This chunk is about:
- People: Osama bin Laden, Joshua L. Wheeler
- Organizations: Al-Qaeda, CIA, Joint Special Operations Command, U.S. National Command Authority
- Military Units: United States Naval Special Warfare Development Group, SEAL Team Six, DEVGRU, 160th Special Operations Aviation Regiment, CIA Special Activities Division, Delta Force
- Operations: Operation Neptune Spear, Operation Inherent Resolve
- Places: Pakistan, Iraq

Facts:
- Osama bin Laden was the founder and head of Al-Qaeda.
- On May 2, 2011, shortly after 1:00 am PKT in Pakistan, United States Navy SEALs from the United States Naval Special Warfare Development Group killed Osama bin Laden.
- The raid that killed Osama bin Laden was code-named Operation Neptune Spear.
- Operation Neptune Spear was a CIA-led operation, and Joint Special Operations Command coordinated the Special Mission Units involved in the raid.
- Units participating under Joint Special Operations Command in Operation Neptune Spear included SEAL Team Six, the 160th Special Operations Aviation Regiment, and operators from the CIA Special Activities Division.
- The United States Naval Special Warfare Development Group is commonly known as DEVGRU or SEAL Team Six.
- The United States Naval Special Warfare Development Group is the U.S. Navy component of Joint Special Operations Command.
- SEAL Team Six remains the unit's widely recognized moniker despite official name changes.
- The United States media sometimes refers to the United States Naval Special Warfare Development Group as a Special Mission Unit.
- Delta Force and DEVGRU perform the most highly complex, classified, and dangerous missions in the U.S. military as directed by the U.S. National Command Authority.
- Joshua L. Wheeler was born on November 22, 1975.
- Joshua L. Wheeler was a United States Army Special Forces Operational Detachment-Delta Master Sergeant.
- Joshua L. Wheeler was also known as a Delta Force Master Sergeant.
- Joshua L. Wheeler was killed in Iraq on October 22, 2015, during Operation Inherent Resolve.
